notes.title: HOW TO RUN YOUR OWN DEDICATED SERVER!
notes.notes:
Hi there, just a quick post to give instructions for eveyone on how to run thier own dedicated server for the new game updates! 

Navigate to your steam folder where age of survival is saved, you will see a folder called "WindowsServer". 

Navigate there and find the executable for the server, which is called AOS2023Server.exe 

Right click and create a shortcut to that file.  Right click the shortcut you just created, and click on properties. 

In the target field AFTER  everything in parenthesis,  add this : -log -server -port=7777

It should look something like :   yourpathhereetcetc\AOS2023Server.exe" -log -server -port=7777

You also want to navigate to the WindowsServer\AOS2023\Content folder and open up the Serverconfig.json file. 

You can edit these parameters to your liking : 

  "Server_Name": "AOS USA West Coast", - please name this to something custom 
  "ServerMap": "Tanganzibar",  - there is only one map right now, but that will change!
  "MaxPublicConnections": 25, - max players 
  "MaxPrivateConnections": 0, - not used yet but will be soon 
  
  "ServerHarvestRate": 1,  - set these rates to your liking
  "ServerExperienceRate": 1



When you are done run your server using the shortcut you created. 

Properly shut down the server by clicking on it's window and pressing CRTL + C  twice, you will see the window close if you have done it properly.  

AVOID CLOSING THE SERVER THROUGH OTHER METHODS like the X button on the window, or ALT + f4. Those methods will not properly close the server, and you may lose experience / buildings / inventory data.


-SilkySullivan

I apologize if you have lost buildings or progress because of this, it is my goal this week to fix that, so if the server crashes for some reason players will only lose progress from the last 5 minutes, instead of the last time the server was properly shut down.

I'm not sure why the server crashes, i'm running the game on AWS servers, at the medium server setting, so it's quite possible it gets overloaded at some point, or other factors may be making it crash,

notes.title: Age of Survival 2024 is uploaded!
notes.notes:
I have just uploaded the 2024 update of Age of Survival!  It is a very early build still.

I originally built the game in the Unity engine, and as everyone knows it wasn't a good release, for a lot of reasons.  I behaved badly towards  the community and bad reviews. A lot of bad things happened,  no more excuses  can be made and my focus is to move forward on the project. 

Moving forward this release is fully multiplayer enabled. I have one dedicated server runnig in the USA WEST region, which can accept 20 concurrent players at one time. 

I have included the server files for you guys, which you can run online yourselves.  In your game folder you will see a folder for the server files. 

You need to open tcp/udp port 7777, and also tcp/udp port 27015 on your router to be able to run a dedicated server from your machine. 

You can edit the server name, the number of players the server will accept, and the spawn rates of items for your servers in the server folder on steam, under AOS2023/content/ServerConfig.json 

Open that file with notepador etc and configure the file to your liking.

I would like you guys to take your best videos if you are into it, and post them here on this post! I will use your videos, and still pics for the steam page, and the new steam trailer.

THe in game menus when you are playing in the map are kinda crappy to navigate through. Press I to get to the inventory menu , then navigate through all the other menus through there... but you have to go back to the inventory menu and press I to close that all out. I realize crappy UI developemnt.  I will work on that for the next update. 

The animal AI is VERY  basic.   This project has been a huge learning experience, and the AI (as well as the whole project), is blueprinted from scratch.  My known issues with the AI, besides the basic behavior are that the agressive AI will freeze up and then decide to pursuit the player in certain situations.  THe passive AI seems to behave pretty well, although also being a pretty basic AI behavior. 

There's not much underwater yet to explore, although  there are two shipwrecks under the map, and some small coral reefs i painted out by hand. 

The animals on land are spawned out in a procedural fassion, but there's no procedural fish spawned out yer in the water in this build.   I just need to do a check for certain parameters within the players radius to the spawn zones  to be able to make tha thappen, and make sure they spawn underwaer and stay there. 

There are some physics oddness with ragdolls when you kill an animal....  the wildebeest is ok, but because of the size of the rhino and it's collision settings it may act oddly with the player when you kill it and loot it. 

Otherwise the majority of the structure of the game is in place....

notes.title: What is the state of the game right now?
notes.notes:
Right now I am working on the "farming" functionality of the game, where one can plant plants in a plot, grow and harvest them over time. 

After that, everything I have planned for this initial re- release of the game is done!

I will of course have to fix a few bugs here and there, and clean and tidy up some things before I release it on steam again, my goal is for this project to be released functional, and be a project that people enjoy playing. 


The only other thing I have to think about is where to host the dedicated server. I currently will probably try AWS (amazon web services) to host the server, but it will cost money after a certain amount of use, and I don't have a lot of that these days. 

Players WILL be able to host a dedicated server themselves if they want to as well of course, via your own computer, or if you want to rent a server space or have access to one. 

I chose dedicated authoritative servers for this project instead of pier to pier multiplayer functionality for a lot of reasons............ security being top on the list, authoritative servers being harder to hack than pier to pier setups,  and also the amount of players an authoritative, dedicated server can accept vs a pier to pier server setup. 

It is a more expensive choice, but I want to make the best choice for the project. 


Otherwise once I finish the farming functionality, it's go time guys! 

I have agreed to let a twitch streamer have full authority of playing the release of the game before it is uploaded to steam, so there won't be a public beta before i upload it to steam. 

The game will though have been tested by many people online, outside of a development environment before I upload it......... So I am trying to give you guys the most tested, bug free version of the initial release of the game that I can put out. 


Cheers and it's getting to be very soon now, I will give you guys one last update with some video footage of the swimming and farming features before we go live.

notes.title: Timeline, and features for the FULL Age of Survival Unreal 5 engine rebuild
notes.notes:
Currently done : 

-Character model and character controller

- inventory system 

- crafting system 

- player statistics system (video coming later tonight) 


What is left to do : 


- armor and equippables 

- the building system 

- storage containers 

- create all of the final items in the game 

- create the social system / clans and tribes system 

- creating the open world map (initially the game will not be an infinite voxel map, but a large map more focused on playability  

- implementing multiple biomes and procedurally generated foliage, rocks, etc onto the terrain 

- creating an AI system 

- creating procedural "zones" (areas of focus)

- creating a minimap 

- creating the load / save system 

- creating the steam sessions and front end widgets for steam 

- creating the dedicated server setup and hosting  


at this point the project will leave early access, and will continue to be updated on a regular basis, and implementing more advanced and in depth features like swimming, fishing, vehicles, drops... etc. 


My timeline for completion from today for all of the essential features, and ready to play on steam is 8 - 10 weeks from this date. 


Please keep in mind this is an ENTIRE rebuild of the game, using no outside purchased assets for programming.  There is no making "this purchased asset" work with "this other purchased asset"  and "that other purchased asset". It's all being done in house, it's all from one source, it is all fully programmed for an authoritative networking system from the beginning. 


My original focus for the setting and artwork will remain, and because I'm using unreal 5, it will look much better than it ever could have on the unity platform.

I have abandoned using unity because of the new pricing model, and to be honest because of limitations using unity.  I have really been enjoying learning the unreal engine, and how powerful is is compared to using unity for developing games. 

I am re writing the game entirely in the blueprint system, and will be using no code from any third party asset purchased. 


Currently developed : 

- first person character controller with custom arms model
- third person view model 
- the project IS programmed entirely for multiplayer, and IS working using a server and client setup rather than using a cheap pier to pier setup. 
- player inventory system and player hotbar are implemented
- testing of a player weapon in 1st person and networked view is fully working 

 In the next video I will be showing the harvesting system (chopping trees, and harvesting ore), animations for the hatchet,  and beginning work on the crafting system. 



I have not given up on what I wanted the project to be from the beginning, and I am spending the time to work on making that happen for everyone who has supported the project.

notes.title: Uploading an early build tomorrow (friday) night!
notes.notes:
Alrighty, so sorry the upload I wanted to upload last week is going slow..... hard to work ft, and have a small baby to take care of, and do this!. haha. who would have known?? 



So the build right now is pretty solid for an early build...............  Things that are working : (single player)

8 different types of animals so far with spawning based on rarity. Animals are procedurally spawned and de spawned around the player, so animals will be spawned infinitely with the terrain. 

infinite voxel terrain with tree, rock, and shrub / plant objects which are all able to be harvested .

Inventory and crafting system. 

Weapon system. 

Player health / damage, hunger and  thirst system (though thirst is disabled for now).

Building system with square and triangular building parts. 

Weather and time of day system .

Saving system (The player's stats, and position. Time of day, date, weather type, inventory contents, and player placed buildings).

Dynamic navigation mesh that generates an updates mesh every 1 second, allowing for AI (animals or otherwise) to be able to navigate on an infinite, procedurally generated terrain. 

Functioning pre loading scenes.





What I am currently working on for the next build to upload : 





Ammo system for the bow and arrow.  (bow currently will shoot as many arrows as you want)

A few small bug fixes with the UI and keypresses.

Biomes (bimes are not currently blending together correctly, but am close to fixing that).

Allowing the player to terraform (dig / place) the terrain, and saving it.

Collision based melee damage  (the current melee system is based on raycast damage, so for instance when hitting an animal's dead corpse to collect meat, etc you need to aim in the middle of your screen on the corpse to hit it, instead of aiming where the axe / etc would hit based on collision with the head of the axe, arrow dame IS currently based on the collision of the arrow with the AI)

Video / audio / input settings.

Working chests and storage items / crafting stations. 

The ability for the player to define random seeds at runtime for varied terrain terrain and object generation. 

Thirst system based on collecting water from roots, and occasional rain, based on a mostly dry environmental setting. 



There are a good amount of crafting layout recipes, I will make a tuturial video of all of the current crafting recipes, and current in game items.

notes.title: Status update
notes.notes:
Just a quick update for the people who do still support the project : 

It's not dead, like I have stated before. In the last year, unfortunately, I have had to stop focusing on development and work a normal fulltime job, as profits from age of survival could not support me or any other developer working full time to continue the project. 

I am continuing development on the project in my free time, including a complete, from the ground up, build of the project for VR only. There have also been times where I have had to wait for certain technologies in unity3d to become available, as they just did not exist beforehand, like navmesh generation for very large terrains, or dynamic navmesh generation for infinite terrains.  

I would like to bring you the main promised features, please do be aware on a one man team, with very limited funds,and even more limited time it will take a great deal of time for me to bring you updates. I have not forgotten the project, and frankly it was my baby for years before release and could never do that. 



I do have to touch on wanting to develop also when I recieve threats, negative comments, etc through email, steam, my personal facebook page, and my personal youtube account. It doesn't make me a happy person, and if you put yourself in my shoes, after reading and deleting such negative comments off of my personal social media avenues it might make a person not want to communicate with the community on steam at the very least.  I'm not telling anyone to stop saying what they are saying, but if you put yourself in my shoes you have to understand how low my motivation to help said people can be at times. 

That is all, please consider that developers are human beings as well. 


I have no timeline for updates unfortunately, but they will come.

Hello steam! 

After launch and reading a lot of bad reviews, I've been doing a ton of re-thinking on the way the different aspects of age of survival are put together and work with each other. There will be a large update coming within the next week which will put in place a new crafting / building / inventory / looting system that is all built to work perfectly with one another, meaning no bugs existing between those types of systems.

A biome system will be coming soon for the voxel terrain, which wil allow for much more diverse environments in the voxel experimental. Besides that the building scripts are also be ing re fractored and cleaned up for optimal performance. Updates are coming a bit slower, as this is again a one person project, but is in no way stale and I will continue to update it for a long while to come.

notes.title: Experimental lauch options now available
notes.notes:
Today we announce the Experimental version of Age of Survival which is now an option when you play the game. It will include rewriting a lot of the game along with new features. We want the game to be as good as it can be and after hiring more people we will be able to deliver. Currently the branch has Virtual Reality (automatically detected when you start the game) and the new tree system (much better performance, less glitchy). Here are some other things coming to experimental in the coming months. 

New inventory system
Procedural map
Fully server authoritative
Better performance
Networked enemies
Vehicles (cars, boats)
New survival mechanics
Clothing/armor system
VOIP
Advanced buildings working like chest, saw mill, and other tiers of buildings
Bolt Steam integration (names, lobby, achievements, joining and inviting friends, backpack)

We will be starting the uploading of more content to the experimental branch very soon. 




Thanks guys, and more build updates coming as usual.

notes.title: Day one survival guide :
notes.notes:
Hey there steam community! Here is the what to do on day one survival guide.

You will see three dedicated servers running for multiplayer, they are located in EU, US east, and  in between US west/ central. If you want to run your own dedicated server, navigate to the age of survival folder on your PC, which should be in : 

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Age of Survival

you may have to replace common with your steam account name. 

From here type : AgeOfSurvival_EarlyAccess.exe -batchmode 

You will get a SERVER RUNNING notice when your server is good to go.

Right now, you have to shut the server down through your task manager. We will be releasing many fixes to how the dedicated servers work during the first initial weeks.

Once you are in game, either single player or multiplayer, your first task is to find a village, and find some wood to craft your first weapon, which will be the beating stick. Villages also contain random loot.

Once you have crafted your first weapon you can now chop down trees, and collect ore. From here you can start to craft a variety of different tools and items. I would suggest starting by crafting the different crafting stations available to you, as some of them are required to craft certain items. 

A list of in game items and crafting recipes can be found on these links on our website : 

In game items : 

http://ageofsurvivalgame.com/itemList.html

Crafting recipes : 

http://ageofsurvivalgame.com/craftingDiagrams.html


There are some features not yet present, and also a few bugs. Do expect for the first week or two that we will be making updates several times during the week to get things in total working order. 

After our initial couple weeks we will be doing very regular updates while we are in early access stages of development. Official update schedule coming very soon.

Above all we thank all of you so much for your support and interest in Age of Survival!

notes.title: Control Remapping, and running your own headless dedicated server
notes.notes:
Hi there! Just added in the new build 0.0.0.1.2.8.3 : 

Control Remapping, including joystick / gamepad support. Needs a little fine tuning for  a few keys (like cancel building, and sklillbar keys. all other keys should work for remapping)

You can run your own server two ways (dedicated servers coming in the next day or two) : 

In game by going to multiplayer, start server. This will process graphics and spawn a player for you.  

by running the game through batchmode in a command prompt : 

Navigate to your steam folder, usually C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Age of Survival

next type : AgeOfSurvival_EarlyAccess.exe -batchmode 

You will see a SERVER RUNNING prompt when the server is running. 

We're also fine tuning this, currently you will have to close our from your task manager. We will add close and restart commands here soon, as well as the ability to name your server. Currently running the game in batchmode will start a server, and also will process sound and spawn a player, in the next couple of days sound and player spawning will be disabled when running as a server in batchmode.

Working on getting all the bugs fixed, and things smoothed out before the release on the 25th. Thanks for your support, ans stay tuned for more!
